# GF-AGING-001 manual oracle

Cutoff is 2026-08-31 in organization local time. Due today is current. Invoice rows cover overdue day boundaries 1, 30, 31, 60, 61, 90, 91 and 92. Partial settlements reduce outstanding only by the reviewed posted amount.

The VND 5,000,000 customer credit is separate from AR debit buckets. The VND 7,000,000 supplier advance is separate from AP credit buckets. Therefore AR control tie is VND 135,000,000 debit open items less VND 5,000,000 customer credit = VND 130,000,000. AP control tie is VND 146,000,000 payable open items less VND 7,000,000 supplier advance = VND 139,000,000.
